# Sounio

> Sounio is a self-hosted systems language for uncertainty, physical units, and declared effects. Follow a program back to the compiler sources.

## Start

- [Sounio language: units, effects, and uncertainty types](https://www.souniolang.org/): Sounio is a self-hosted systems language for uncertainty, physical units, and declared effects. Follow a program back to the compiler sources.
- [Sounio guides: effect system, units, and uncertainty](https://www.souniolang.org/learn/): Language guides for Sounio: units of measure, the effect system, refinement types, uncertainty propagation, and the self-hosted compiler.
- [Sounio getting started: Linux prebuilt or macOS build](https://www.souniolang.org/learn/getting-started/): Clone Sounio, then check and run a .sio program. Linux x86-64 uses the committed prebuilt; macOS ARM64 builds the compiler from source.

## Language

- [Units and Uncertainty — Sounio](https://www.souniolang.org/learn/language/units-and-uncertainty/): Compile-time unit checking and GUM-based uncertainty propagation in Sounio
- [Sounio vs mp-units vs physure: units + uncertainty](https://www.souniolang.org/learn/epistemic/sounio-vs-mp-units-vs-physure/): Compare Sounio 3.0 (pre-release), mp-units, and physure for units plus correlated uncertainty — and when the language-level option fits.
- [Sounio self-hosted compiler: x86-64 ELF without LLVM](https://www.souniolang.org/learn/compiler/self-hosted/): The Sounio compiler runs 12 named -O passes and emits a Linux x86-64 ELF, static unless external relocations exist, with no LLVM and no Cranelift.

## Project

- [Science — Sounio](https://www.souniolang.org/science/): Domain applications and scientific workflows powered by Sounio
- [Insights — Sounio](https://www.souniolang.org/insights/): Research updates, release notes, and engineering writing from Sounio
- [About Sounio and creator Demetrios Chiuratto Agourakis](https://www.souniolang.org/about/): Sounio is an open-source language for units and uncertainty, created by Demetrios Chiuratto Agourakis (PUC-SP). Project facts, contributors and links.
